aggressive.read: This aggressive growth plan targets ~4%/month by using and adding leveraged ETFs and concentrating in high-scoring setups. Be aware this significantly raises both upside and drawdown potential, leveraged ETFs decay daily, and strict stop discipline is crucial to manage substantial potential losses.
